newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Utd Tech sees '96 net in line with forecast.
newsitem.headline: Utd Tech sees '96 net in line with forecast.

text.p: United Technologies Corp President George David said on Tuesday he was comfortable with a Wall Street consensus forecast of net earnings in 1996 of $6.73 per share.
"That is an estimate by others with which we feel comfortable," he told Reuters while on a visit to Jakarta.
David also said he was comfortable with an estimate of a 15 percent increase in profit in 1997 over 1996.
He said this would put per share profits at $7.75 next year from $6.73 in 1996.
David is in Indonesia as chairman of the private sector U.S.-ASEAN Economic Council, which will be meeting on Wednesday and Thursday on the island of Batam, near Singapore.
ASEAN, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, groups Brunei, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
